lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gills, with a notable increase in centroid diameter along the mid-lateral line compared to the smaller, more densely packed spots on the dorsal surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal arrangements of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where the largest blobs act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow transition gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch or indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. Irregular white linear streaks are visible on the upper flank, indicating potential parasitic scarring or abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral surface near the base of the pectoral fin.
